database_note: The Engagements table records all booking events, linking Customers, Agents, and Entertainers via their respective IDs. Entertainers are defined in the Entertainers table, with individual performers stored in Members and linked through Entertainer_Members. Entertainer capabilities are described in Entertainer_Styles, connecting to Musical_Styles. Customer tastes are tracked in Musical_Preferences, also linking to Musical_Styles. The remaining tables serve as lookups or dimensions. Musical_Styles defines genre options. Calendar tables ztblDays, ztblMonths, and ztblWeeks support time-based analysis by providing date ranges. ztblSkipLabels is a helper for sequential labeling. Agents and Customers provide contact details. Use EngagementNumber as the primary event identifier, joining to other tables via their specific ID columns to enrich transaction data with descriptive attributes.
